mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS projectId, p.project_code AS projectCode, p.project_name AS projectName, p.infrastructure_type AS infrastructureType, p.status AS projectStatus, p.location_text AS locationText, p.longitude AS longitude, p.latitude AS latitude, COALESCE( CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.spatial_context_json, '$.monitoringPointCount')) AS UNSIGNED), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_station s WHERE s.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(s.enabled, 1) = 1) ) AS siteCount, COALESCE( CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.spatial_context_json, '$.monitoringPointCount')) AS UNSIGNED), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_station s WHERE s.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(s.enabled, 1) = 1) ) AS stationCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_station s WHERE s.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(s.enabled, 1) = 1) AS stationRecordCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_instrument i WHERE i.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(i.enabled, 1) = 1) AS instrumentCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.module_no) FROM em_instrument i WHERE i.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(i.enabled, 1) = 1 AND i.module_no IS NOT NULL) AS acquisitionModuleCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.dtu_code) FROM em_instrument i WHERE i.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(i.enabled, 1) = 1 AND i.dtu_code IS NOT NULL) AS dtuCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_station_metric sm WHERE sm.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(sm.enabled, 1) = 1) AS stationMetricCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_observation_table_registry r WHERE r.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(r.enabled, 1) = 1) AS registryCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_monitoring_event e WHERE e.project_id = p.id) AS eventCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_monitoring_event e WHERE e.project_id = p.id AND e.event_status IN ('open', 'OPEN')) AS openEventCount, (SELECT MAX(e.detected_at) FROM em_monitoring_event e WHERE e.project_id = p.id) AS latestEventTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_notification_task n WHERE n.project_id = p.id) AS notificationTaskCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_report_instance ri WHERE ri.project_id = p.id) AS reportInstanceCount, ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_obs_displacement o WHERE o.project_id = p.id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_obs_earth_pressure o WHERE o.project_id = p.id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_obs_pressure_water_level o WHERE o.project_id = p.id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_obs_static_level o WHERE o.project_id = p.id)) AS lowFrequencyObservationCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ab.sample_count), 0) FROM em_accel_batch ab WHERE ab.project_id = p.id) AS accelerationSampleCount, ( SELECT MAX(x.t) FROM ( SELECT MAX(o.observed_at) AS t FROM em_obs_displacement o WHERE o.project_id = p.id UNION ALL SELECT MAX(o.observed_at) FROM em_obs_earth_pressure o WHERE o.project_id = p.id UNION ALL SELECT MAX(o.observed_at) FROM em_obs_pressure_water_level o WHERE o.project_id = p.id UNION ALL SELECT MAX(o.observed_at) FROM em_obs_static_level o WHERE o.project_id = p.id UNION ALL SELECT MAX(COALESCE(ab.end_time, ab.start_time)) AS t FROM em_accel_batch ab WHERE ab.project_id = p.id ) x ) AS latestObservationTime FROM em_project p WHERE p.id = #{projectId}

SELECT p.id AS projectId, p.project_code AS projectCode, p.project_name AS projectName, p.infrastructure_type AS infrastructureType, p.status AS projectStatus, p.location_text AS locationText, p.longitude AS longitude, p.latitude AS latitude, COALESCE( CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.spatial_context_json, '$.monitoringPointCount')) AS UNSIGNED), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_station s WHERE s.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(s.enabled, 1) = 1) ) AS siteCount, COALESCE( CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.spatial_context_json, '$.monitoringPointCount')) AS UNSIGNED), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_station s WHERE s.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(s.enabled, 1) = 1) ) AS stationCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_station s WHERE s.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(s.enabled, 1) = 1) AS stationRecordCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_instrument i WHERE i.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(i.enabled, 1) = 1) AS instrumentCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.module_no) FROM em_instrument i WHERE i.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(i.enabled, 1) = 1 AND i.module_no IS NOT NULL) AS acquisitionModuleCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.dtu_code) FROM em_instrument i WHERE i.project_id = p.id AND IFNULL(i.enabled, 1) = 1 AND i.dtu_code IS NOT NULL) AS dtuCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_monitoring_event e WHERE e.project_id = p.id) AS eventCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM em_monitoring_event e WHERE e.project_id = p.id AND e.event_status IN ('open', 'OPEN')) AS openEventCount, ( SELECT MAX(x.t) FROM ( SELECT MAX(o.observed_at) AS t FROM em_obs_displacement o WHERE o.project_id = p.id UNION ALL SELECT MAX(o.observed_at) FROM em_obs_earth_pressure o WHERE o.project_id = p.id UNION ALL SELECT MAX(o.observed_at) FROM em_obs_pressure_water_level o WHERE o.project_id = p.id UNION ALL SELECT MAX(o.observed_at) FROM em_obs_static_level o WHERE o.project_id = p.id UNION ALL SELECT MAX(COALESCE(ab.end_time, ab.start_time)) AS t FROM em_accel_batch ab WHERE ab.project_id = p.id ) x ) AS latestObservationTime FROM em_project p ORDER BY p.id
SELECT station_type AS itemCode, COUNT(*) AS itemCount FROM em_station WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND IFNULL(enabled, 1) = 1 GROUP BY station_type ORDER BY itemCount DESC, itemCode ASC
SELECT instrument_type AS itemCode, COUNT(*) AS itemCount FROM em_instrument WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND IFNULL(enabled, 1) = 1 GROUP BY instrument_type ORDER BY itemCount DESC, itemCode ASC
SELECT metric_code AS itemCode, COUNT(*) AS itemCount FROM em_station_metric WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND IFNULL(enabled, 1) = 1 GROUP BY metric_code ORDER BY itemCount DESC, itemCode ASC
SELECT event_level AS itemCode, COUNT(*) AS itemCount FROM em_monitoring_event WHERE project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY event_level ORDER BY itemCount DESC, itemCode ASC

SELECT dataset_code AS datasetCode, dataset_name AS datasetName, scenario_type AS scenarioType, input_description AS inputDescription, dataset_uri AS datasetUri, time_start AS timeStart, time_end AS timeEnd, expected_result_hash AS expectedResultHash, license, citation, reproducibility_level AS reproducibilityLevel FROM em_dataset_manifest WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
